# Juniper Lantern fees and terms

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

Term tuition is $180 for Moss Steps, $195 for Lantern Jazz, $190 for Reed Ballet, $210 for Cloud Contemporary, and $165 for Pebble Creative. A second sibling gets 10 percent off tuition only; the discount does not cover trial fees, costumes, or workshops. Costume hire is $28 per item per term. An invoice balance and payment receipt are live account records, not facts in this document. The office handles payment plans individually; this document promises no approval or particular instalment schedule.
